purpose: host whole-entry sentence-by-sentence precheck of long lore entries before the first EXECUTOR dispatch (window 38 lesson)
method: the host compared the long entries 5d8d908f72, 619199a9ea, 4f11cda37a, 5362d5e743, 4e560f2e5a and 5bb911ddb9 sentence by sentence (and line by line for LF structure) against the frozen workset; findings already covered by SOURCE-CLAIMS are not repeated; every quoted phrase below was machine-checked against the workset; these are in addition to SOURCE-CLAIMS

items:
P1 "My fellow councilors," 是独立称呼段，源文其后为 

；现译“议员同志们，”直接接正文，全条少一个 

（源 11 处、译 10 处，LF 不变量）。补回为独立首段（如“议员同志们：”后接 

）。

P3 "or a pitiful, fallen reminder of why letting the lesser races use our discoveries will only end in tragedy" 仍是 They did not explicitly tell us that they are … 的第三个表语，指兽人本身是可悲、堕落的活例证；现译“也没有留下一个可悲的警示”改成祖先留下警示。建议“……或是一个可悲的、堕落的活例证，提醒我们让下等种族使用我们的发明只会以悲剧收场”。

P4 "the mentions of their boorish behavior are recorded in a matter-of-fact nature" 现译“确实完全实事求是的”语病（应为转折“却是……实事求是的”）；"the mountains of Maj'Eyal" 现译“马基埃亚尔”，术语 terminology/places.tsv:46 Maj'Eyal＝马基·埃亚尔（preferred）。
P10 "cannot be good for anyone, least of all ourselves" 现译“这不可能对任何人有好处”漏 least of all ourselves，补“尤其是对我们自己”。
P11 "stricken from the record by 4-2 vote" 现译“削除”为错字，应作“删除”。

P12 "All because you can't accept …" 与 "more than they want [i]your[/i] way of doing things" 的 you 指卡西罗斯一人（P10 已作“你”），现译“你们”“[i]你们[/i]”改为“你”“[i]你[/i]”（保留 [i] 标记）；"we have or can obtain the means to carry it out" 现译“解决困难的方式”，应为“实施这一计划的手段”。
P13 "gave a lengthy speech before officially resigning from the Council" 现译“在从议会正式辞职时做了一个不短的演讲”把 before 译成“时”，改“在正式辞去议会职务前发表了一篇长篇演讲”。
P1 "offering him his previous terms of agreement" 指接受忠诚者先前提出的协议条件；现译“向他提供我们之前在协议中许诺的东西”把条件主体改成我方。建议“并接受他先前提出的协议条件”。"bring the Eye with us" 的 Eye 是神器，同 DLC palace-fumes 作“眼”，现译“眼睛”，改为“眼”。
P5 "projected journey to the Loyalist's last known position is underway" 现译“正在准备前往忠诚者的上一个位置”：underway＝已在进行，last known position＝最后已知位置。建议“前往忠诚者最后已知位置的预定航程正在进行”。
LF 不变量：源文标题行 "#{bold}#CLOGGING NO MORE!#{normal}#" 后直接换行接 "If steam-vent congestion ails you"（中间无空行），现译标题后多一个空行（源 13 个 LF、译 14 个）；删除标题后的空行。源文其余仅含空格的行在译文中保持为空行，不补空格。
